content.json:
# AI Governance Observability
Telemetry from the local chat and MCP services. This workbook reads existing Application Insights data; it does not configure collection or execute agent actions.

Governance denials are policy outcomes, not necessarily failed spans. Spans may be sampled; an empty chart is not proof of service health. The recent-span IDs support investigation, but do not establish complete chat-to-model-to-MCP correlation. No prompts, responses, member records, or tool payloads are shown.

content.title: Last received telemetry by service (not a health probe)
Governance decisions by service and outcome
content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName in ("ai-governance-harness-chat", "ai-governance-harness-mcp")
| where name == "governance.policy.decision.count"
| extend Decision=tostring(customDimensions["governance.decision"])
| summarize Decisions=sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 5m), Service=cloud_RoleName, Decision
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: Mean policy evaluation duration (ms, weighted by evaluations)
content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName in ("ai-governance-harness-chat", "ai-governance-harness-mcp")
| where name == "governance.policy.evaluation.duration"
| summarize TotalSeconds=sum(valueSum), Evaluations=sum(valueCount) by bin(timestamp, 5m), Service=cloud_RoleName
| where Evaluations > 0
| extend MeanDurationMs=1000.0 * TotalSeconds / Evaluations
| project timestamp, Service, MeanDurationMs
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: MCP HTTP request volume
content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "ai-governance-harness-mcp"
| where name == "mcp.http.request.count"
| summarize Requests=sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: MCP tool call volume
content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "ai-governance-harness-mcp"
| where name == "mcp.tool.call.count"
| extend Tool=tostring(customDimensions["mcp.tool.name"])
| summarize Calls=sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 5m), Tool
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: Recorded span duration and failures (sampled span evidence)
content.query:
union withsource=SpanTable requests, dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName in ("ai-governance-harness-chat", "ai-governance-harness-mcp")
| summarize RecordedSpans=count(), FailedSpans=countif(success == false), UnknownOutcome=countif(isnull(success)), MeanDuration=avg(duration), P95Duration=percentile(duration, 95) by Service=cloud_RoleName, SpanTable, name
| order by FailedSpans desc, RecordedSpans desc
| take 50

content.title: Recent OTel spans and operation IDs
content.query:
union withsource=SpanTable requests, dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName in ("ai-governance-harness-chat", "ai-governance-harness-mcp")
| project timestamp, Service=cloud_RoleName, SpanTable, name, duration, success, operation_Id, operation_ParentId, id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 100

content.json:
## Investigate a trace
Copy an `operation_Id` from the table, open **Logs** on this Application Insights resource, and query:

```kusto
union requests, dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where operation_Id == "<operation-id>"
| project timestamp, cloud_RoleName, name, duration, success, id, operation_ParentId
| order by timestamp asc
```

OTel spans live in `requests` and `dependencies`; `traces` contains log records. These queries use Application Insights resource-scoped table names. Workspace-scoped queries use `AppRequests`, `AppDependencies`, and `AppMetrics` with different columns. Histogram means use aggregated sums and counts; span percentiles describe retained spans, not a policy-duration histogram percentile.
